Fixes the name under the logo in the app sidebar, which still read BasePilot in v1.0.10. Nothing else changes: everything in [v1.0.10](https://github.com/Leixien/pixelchief/releases/tag/v1.0.10) applies.

Download **PixelChief.exe**. Tesseract is bundled. **PixelChief.exe.sha256** contains its SHA-256 checksum. The exe is unsigned, so SmartScreen warns on first launch.

Guide and tester form: https://leixien.github.io/pixelchief/
